mcqs.question: Who announced the plan for US dollar notes to carry President Trump's signature, with the $100 note scheduled first in June 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the $100 note would be the first US currency note to carry Trump's signature in June 2026. Donald Trump's signature is the subject of the announcement, while the Commission of Fine Arts approved a separate 24-carat gold coin featuring his image.
